units.locator: Article 26. Powers of the City Duma
units.text: 1) approving the structure of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg on the proposal of the Head of Yekaterinburg;
units.label: Subpoint 1 Point 2 Art. 26

units.locator: Article 26. Powers of the City Duma
units.text: 2) repealed by Decision of the Yekaterinburg City Duma of 08.04.2014 No. 8/14;
units.label: Subpoint 2 Point 2 Art. 26

units.locator: Article 26. Powers of the City Duma
units.text: 3) repealed with effect from 31 October 2022 by Decision of the Yekaterinburg City Duma of 09.08.2022 No. 26/76;
units.label: Subpoint 3 Point 2 Art. 26

units.locator: Article 26. Powers of the City Duma
units.text: 4) submitting initiatives to state authorities of Sverdlovsk Oblast to change the boundaries or transform the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg”;
units.label: Subpoint 4 Point 2 Art. 26

units.locator: Article 26. Powers of the City Duma
units.text: 5) calling municipal elections and local referendums;
units.label: Subpoint 5 Point 2 Art. 26

units.locator: Article 26. Powers of the City Duma
units.text: 6) establishing the procedure for preparing, considering and approving the draft municipal budget and for executing and overseeing execution of the municipal budget; deciding the period for which the draft municipal budget is prepared and approved — one year (the next financial year) or three years (the next financial year and the planning period); and establishing the procedure for approving the report on execution of the municipal budget for the preceding financial year;
units.label: Subpoint 6 Point 2 Art. 26

units.locator: Article 26. Powers of the City Duma
units.text: 7) repealed by Decision of the Yekaterinburg City Duma of 08.04.2014 No. 8/14;
units.label: Subpoint 7 Point 2 Art. 26

units.locator: Article 26. Powers of the City Duma
units.text: 8) establishing the procedure for providing municipal guarantees and for municipal loans (borrowing);
units.label: Subpoint 8 Point 2 Art. 26

units.locator: Article 26. Powers of the City Duma
units.text: 9) adopting regulatory legal acts on other financial and budgetary matters in accordance with legislation;
units.label: Subpoint 9 Point 2 Art. 26

units.locator: Article 26. Powers of the City Duma
units.text: 9-1) hearing annual reports by the Head of Yekaterinburg on the results of the Head’s activities and those of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg, including the resolution of matters raised by the City Duma;
units.label: Subpoint 9-1 Point 2 Art. 26

units.locator: Article 26. Powers of the City Duma
units.text: 10) other matters in accordance with federal laws, laws of Sverdlovsk Oblast and this Charter.
units.label: Subpoint 10 Point 2 Art. 26

units.locator: Article 27. Structure of the City Duma
units.text: Article 27. Structure of the City Duma
units.label: Art. 27

units.locator: Article 27. Structure of the City Duma
units.text: 1. The City Duma independently determines its structure in accordance with this Charter.
units.label: Point 1 Art. 27

units.locator: Article 27. Structure of the City Duma
units.text: 2. The activities of the City Duma are organized by the Chair of the City Duma, elected from among the deputies according to the procedure determined by the City Duma.
units.label: Point 2 Art. 27

units.locator: Article 27. Structure of the City Duma
units.text: 3. The First Deputy Chair of the City Duma and the Deputy Chair of the City Duma (hereinafter also referred to as the Deputy Chairs of the City Duma) are elected from among the deputies of the City Duma. The procedure for electing the Deputy Chairs of the City Duma is determined by the Rules of Procedure of the City Duma.
units.label: Point 3 Art. 27

units.locator: Article 27. Structure of the City Duma
units.text: 4. The Chair of the City Duma and the Deputy Chairs of the City Duma are local self-government officials. The Chair of the City Duma and the First Deputy Chair of the City Duma exercise their powers on a full-time basis.
units.label: Point 4 Art. 27

units.locator: Article 27. Structure of the City Duma
units.text: 5. The City Duma establishes standing and temporary commissions. The procedure for their formation and the organization of their work are determined by the Rules of Procedure of the City Duma and by regulations on the commissions approved by the City Duma.
units.label: Point 5 Art. 27

units.locator: Article 27. Structure of the City Duma
units.text: 6. Deputies of the City Duma may establish deputy groups. The procedure for establishing deputy groups and for their activities is determined by the Rules of Procedure of the City Duma and regulations on deputy groups.
units.label: Point 6 Art. 27

units.locator: Article 27. Structure of the City Duma
units.text: Deputies of the City Duma elected as part of lists of candidates nominated by political parties (their regional branches or other structural subdivisions) belong to deputy associations (factions), except in cases provided for by the federal law establishing the general principles of the organization of local self-government in the Russian Federation.
units.label: Point 6 Art. 27 · “Deputies of the City Duma elected as part of lists of…”

units.locator: Article 27. Structure of the City Duma
units.text: 7. The staff of the City Duma is formed to provide organizational, information, legal and logistical support for the activities of deputies and standing and temporary commissions.
units.label: Point 7 Art. 27

units.locator: Article 27. Structure of the City Duma
units.text: Article 27-1. Powers of the Chair of the City Duma
units.label: Point 7 Art. 27 · “Article 27-1. Powers of the Chair of the City Duma”

units.locator: Article 27. Structure of the City Duma
units.text: 1. The Chair of the City Duma exercises the following powers:
units.label: Point 1 Art. 27

units.locator: Article 27. Structure of the City Duma
units.text: 1) represents the City Duma in relations with the population of the municipality, state authorities, local self-government bodies and officials, and organizations irrespective of their form of ownership, and in conducting international relations;
units.label: Subpoint 1 Point 1 Art. 27

units.locator: Article 27. Structure of the City Duma
units.text: 2) organizes the reception of citizens and organizations at the City Duma;
units.label: Subpoint 2 Point 1 Art. 27

units.locator: Article 27. Structure of the City Duma
units.text: 3) informs the population of the municipality about the activities of the City Duma;
units.label: Subpoint 3 Point 1 Art. 27

units.locator: Article 27. Structure of the City Duma
units.text: 4) ensures that public opinion is taken into account when the City Duma adopts decisions;
units.label: Subpoint 4 Point 1 Art. 27

units.locator: Article 27. Structure of the City Duma
units.text: 5) ensures interaction between the City Duma and other local self-government bodies of the municipality;
units.label: Subpoint 5 Point 1 Art. 27

units.locator: Article 27. Structure of the City Duma
units.text: 6) concludes contracts and agreements on behalf of the City Duma;
units.label: Subpoint 6 Point 1 Art. 27

units.locator: Article 27. Structure of the City Duma
units.text: 7) acts on behalf of the City Duma without a power of attorney;
units.label: Subpoint 7 Point 1 Art. 27

units.locator: Article 27. Structure of the City Duma
units.text: 8) organizes the work of the City Duma, coordinates the activities of its standing and temporary commissions, and issues instructions on matters within their purview;
units.label: Subpoint 8 Point 1 Art. 27

units.locator: Article 27. Structure of the City Duma
units.text: 9) convenes ordinary and extraordinary meetings of the City Duma and informs deputies and the public of their time and place and the draft agenda;
units.label: Subpoint 9 Point 1 Art. 27

units.locator: Article 27. Structure of the City Duma
units.text: 10) prepares meetings of the City Duma and chairs its meetings;
units.label: Subpoint 10 Point 1 Art. 27

units.locator: Article 27. Structure of the City Duma
units.text: 11) issues resolutions and executive orders on the organization of the activities of the City Duma and its staff, and signs decisions of the City Duma and minutes of its meetings;
units.label: Subpoint 11 Point 1 Art. 27

units.locator: Article 27. Structure of the City Duma
units.text: 12) opens and closes the City Duma’s ledger accounts and administers its funds in accordance with the approved expenditure estimate;
units.label: Subpoint 12 Point 1 Art. 27

units.locator: Article 27. Structure of the City Duma
units.text: 13) issues powers of attorney;
units.label: Subpoint 13 Point 1 Art. 27

units.locator: Article 27. Structure of the City Duma
units.text: 14) files statements of claim, other applications and complaints with courts and takes measures to safeguard the interests of the City Duma in court;
units.label: Subpoint 14 Point 1 Art. 27

units.locator: Article 27. Structure of the City Duma
units.text: 15) organizes professional education and additional professional education for deputies of the City Duma, as well as professional education and additional professional education for municipal servants holding municipal-service posts in the City Duma;
units.label: Subpoint 15 Point 1 Art. 27

units.locator: Article 27. Structure of the City Duma
units.text: 16) exercises overall supervision of the work of the staff of the City Duma;
units.label: Subpoint 16 Point 1 Art. 27

units.locator: Article 27. Structure of the City Duma
units.text: 17) exercises the powers of the representative of the appointing authority (employer);
units.label: Subpoint 17 Point 1 Art. 27

units.locator: Article 27. Structure of the City Duma
units.text: 18) exercises other powers provided for by legislation and decisions of the City Duma.
units.label: Subpoint 18 Point 1 Art. 27

units.locator: Article 27. Structure of the City Duma
units.text: 2. In the absence of the Chair of the City Duma, the powers provided for by this Article of the Charter are exercised, on the Chair’s executive order, by the First Deputy Chair of the City Duma.
units.label: Point 2 Art. 27

units.locator: Article 27. Structure of the City Duma
units.text: 3. The powers of the Deputy Chairs of the City Duma are determined by the Rules of Procedure of the City Duma and decisions of the City Duma.
units.label: Point 3 Art. 27

units.locator: Article 28. Repealed as of 23 November 2010. — Decision of the Yekaterinburg City Duma of 12.10.2010 No. 62/29.
units.text: Article 28. Repealed as of 23 November 2010. — Decision of the Yekaterinburg City Duma of 12.10.2010 No. 62/29.
units.label: Art. 28

units.locator: Article 29. Deputy of the City Duma
units.text: Article 29. Deputy of the City Duma
units.label: Art. 29

units.locator: Article 29. Deputy of the City Duma
units.text: 1. A citizen of the Russian Federation who has electoral rights and has reached the age of 18 may be elected a deputy of the City Duma.
units.label: Point 1 Art. 29

units.locator: Article 29. Deputy of the City Duma
units.text: 2. A deputy’s powers commence on the day of election and cease on the day the City Duma of the new convocation begins its work, except in cases of early termination of a City Duma deputy’s powers provided for by federal legislation and this Charter.
units.label: Point 2 Art. 29

units.locator: Article 29. Deputy of the City Duma
units.text: 3. Deputies of the City Duma generally exercise their powers on a non-full-time basis. The number of City Duma deputies working on a full-time basis is established by the City Duma in accordance with federal legislation.
units.label: Point 3 Art. 29

units.locator: Article 29. Deputy of the City Duma
units.text: 4. A deputy of the City Duma carries out their activities in all forms not prohibited by the Constitution of the Russian Federation, federal and oblast legislation or this Charter.
units.label: Point 4 Art. 29

units.locator: Article 29. Deputy of the City Duma
units.text: 5. The status of a deputy of the City Duma is determined by federal law and the law of Sverdlovsk Oblast.
units.label: Point 5 Art. 29

units.locator: Article 29. Deputy of the City Duma
units.text: 6. Guarantees for the exercise of the powers of a deputy of the City Duma are established by this Charter in accordance with federal laws and the laws of Sverdlovsk Oblast.
units.label: Point 6 Art. 29

units.locator: Article 30. Forms of deputies’ activities
units.text: Article 30. Forms of deputies’ activities
units.label: Art. 30

units.locator: Article 30. Forms of deputies’ activities
units.text: 1. A deputy of the City Duma is provided with conditions for the unimpeded exercise of their powers.
units.label: Point 1 Art. 30

units.locator: Article 30. Forms of deputies’ activities
units.text: 2. A deputy of the City Duma participates in resolving all matters within the competence of the City Duma.
units.label: Point 2 Art. 30

units.locator: Article 30. Forms of deputies’ activities
units.text: 3. The forms of a City Duma deputy’s activities are:
units.label: Point 3 Art. 30

units.locator: Article 30. Forms of deputies’ activities
units.text: 1) work with voters;
units.label: Subpoint 1 Point 3 Art. 30

units.locator: Article 30. Forms of deputies’ activities
units.text: 2) participation in meetings of the City Duma;
units.label: Subpoint 2 Point 3 Art. 30

units.locator: Article 30. Forms of deputies’ activities
units.text: 3) participation in the work of commissions of the City Duma;
units.label: Subpoint 3 Point 3 Art. 30

units.locator: Article 30. Forms of deputies’ activities
units.text: 4) performance of assignments from the City Duma;
units.label: Subpoint 4 Point 3 Art. 30

units.locator: Article 30. Forms of deputies’ activities
units.text: 5) participation in deputies’ hearings;
units.label: Subpoint 5 Point 3 Art. 30

units.locator: Article 30. Forms of deputies’ activities
units.text: 6) submission of a deputy’s interpellation;
units.label: Subpoint 6 Point 3 Art. 30

units.locator: Article 30. Forms of deputies’ activities
units.text: 7) participation in the work of deputy associations, deputy groups and factions in the City Duma;
units.label: Subpoint 7 Point 3 Art. 30

units.locator: Article 30. Forms of deputies’ activities
units.text: 8) addressing questions to officials of local self-government bodies.
units.label: Subpoint 8 Point 3 Art. 30

units.locator: Article 30. Forms of deputies’ activities
units.text: Deputies’ activities may also take other forms provided for by the Constitution of the Russian Federation, federal laws, the Charter of Sverdlovsk Oblast, the laws of Sverdlovsk Oblast, the Charter of the Municipality “City of Yekaterinburg” and the Rules of Procedure of the City Duma.
units.label: Subpoint 8 Point 3 Art. 30 · “Deputies’ activities may also take other forms provided for by…”

units.locator: Article 30. Forms of deputies’ activities
units.text: 4. A deputy of the City Duma is provided with logistical and organizational resources.
units.label: Point 4 Art. 30
